text: G49's readings 68 to 74, stated while reading A17's restrict window r588_000 (16 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (68) Restrict lines are ruled by G9 with G49's classes: S-O-A, S-O-H and S-BOUND as specifications, and the evidence limits EL-AFTER, EL-NT, EL-ONE, EL-NA, EL-V and EL-J (one act, or hours that cannot be placed). A condition that the talk answers a neighbour's complaint or accusation, not a call, is held by A17's connection, which counts the room's act as well as its call, and by reading 22 and G48's reading 3, which count the room's act a neighbour tells of, meant or not (FederationPlace-057, Russiaclan-049: S-O-A; FloydVsVoid-065, in the post's words: S-O-H). (69) A condition that the answer invokes an agreement the call did not cause is held by the mechanism, which says the room invokes a truce, and by the connection, which counts an order (Peru-060): S-O-A. (70) A condition that peace offers or a truce request can come before an attack call, or that a deal can oblige an attack on a third room, is held by A17's bound and counterexample response, which count rooms that talk borders before any attack call, and for the joint fight by P17 under G4a (DatBoi-056, catalunya-053, aggies-057): S-BOUND, where the concepts show the talk first. (71) A condition that the talk answers an alarm, an incursion or a call to defend is held by the connection's first end, so such a line shows no first end (AyyMD-047, Temple-048, bindingofisaac-063, cardinals-057): EL-NA; so does a principled refusal to contest another room's taking of the room's flag, A16's form under G4a (anarchism-064). (72) A rival's threat against the room's work, after the room's offers of talks, is not the room's attack (anime-071 c0127): EL-ONE. (73) A ceasefire request whose fight the coded posts do not place, with the room's attack told first as a stated intent and after the close as a recount, cannot be placed against the talk (MMA-062): EL-J. (74) A proposal inside the room that it needs a truce is not terms, as readings 14 and 64 (armenia-050 c0089): EL-NT; a proposal to ask permission first shown at h+73.23 is after the close (chile-053 c0131): EL-AFTER. No line in this window states a condition A17, its bound and its counterexample response lack and shows the order failing without it.

G49's readings 75 to 83, stated while reading A17's restrict window r588_016 (16 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (75) A neighbour's offer of another site and help, answering the room's call to build on the neighbour's spot, answers the attack call, even where the room then declares war; the connection counts the order of first acts, not an end to fighting (clashroyale-051, with the submission's c0372 at h+55.54 as the first end, R): S-O-A. (76) Permission from the maker of a neighbouring work, where the record does not show that the maker spoke for a room, is an evidence limit, as G18 read uruguay-024 (criticalrole-049 c0050): EL-NT. (77) A neighbour's post that tells of the room's destruction and asks for a treaty, or of the room's border that set it back and asks for lenience, shows the order in its words, as readings 13 and 22 (croatia-056 c0122; httyd-053 c0044): S-O-H; a later offer to attack a third room for the neighbour is a joint fight, P17's (httyd-053 c0049). (78) A neighbour's request that the room accept the neighbour's taking of part of the room's work is terms; where it comes before the room's first coded attack, a threat that answers it, it is the bound's pattern (cubers-078 c0100, c0103): S-BOUND. (79) Recounts first shown after hour 73 are after the close (detroitlions-056): EL-AFTER. (80) Reciprocal overwriting that a member reports, in which the room keeps replacing the other room's pixels, is the room's act against another room's work, and the neighbour's offer in another thread follows it by the hours (duckgame-053 c0010, c0017): S-O-H; a member's stated wish to try to work out a deal is a proposal to ask (c0016). (81) Trying to cooperate names no agreement, as reading 60 (eve-055 c0232): EL-NT; help for an attack, offered to visitors, is help traded for help, P16's (falcons-073 c0173, c0190): EL-NT. (82) The target's request to negotiate, or a neighbour's offer, in another thread after the room's proposal to invade, follows it by the hours (formula1-054 c0336; iceland-032 c0077): S-O-H; a coded call in the submission of a later attack's thread, at h+14.39, is the first end, before the room's terms with the target in another thread at h+39.56 (habs-062 c0062, R): S-O-H. (83) An alarm about another room's plan to delete the room's work is not the room's attack (ice_poseidon-034 c0204): EL-NA; a reply that holds members to a treaty under a post with no code shows only terms (italy-045 c0036), as does a request for a compromise under a submission that reports another room's permission (jerma985-055): EL-ONE. Also: coldplay-056 S-O-A, a member's report of his own act on a neighbour's work answered by settled boundaries (INV). No line in this window states a condition A17, its bound and its counterexample response lack and shows the order failing without it.

G49's readings 84 to 92, stated while reading A17's restrict window r588_032 (16 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (84) A neighbour's request that the room spread elsewhere so as not to cover its work names a place, so it is terms by G18's reading of appeals, and it names the work the spread would cover, so the spread is an attack call, as G48's reading 4 (mechanicalkeyboards-048: the submission's c0144 at h+41.71, then c0145, R): S-O-A; a neighbour's invitation to discuss a space it is using answers the room's placement there in the same way (lifeisstrange-040 c0051, c0052): S-O-A. (85) The bound's pattern, S-BOUND: a neighbour's request for a border in a submission before the room's first attack proposal (miamidolphins-051 c0119 at h+59.93, before c0124 at h+60.80); coded talk of terms before the first coded act of the room's, as reading 5 (opticgaming-061 c0092 at h+45.17, before c0139 at h+58.57); a treaty made before a later takeover call (parahumans-064 c0058, before c0195); a truce request reported before any coded attack (partyparrot-066 c0010 at h+19.08, before c0039 at h+35.45); and a negotiation reported before the room's counterplacement (placetardis-055 c0061, before c0063). (86) A neighbour's post that tells of the room's destruction and asks for a truce shows the order in its words, as reading 77 (osugame-060 c0258), and so does a post that reports members breaking a truce with a neighbour, as reading 45 (reddevils-063 c0136): S-O-H; an accusation of the room's encroachment answered by a border promise shows the order in the thread (nlsscirclejerk-049 c0062, c0065): S-O-A. (87) A post that announces a plan to move onto a third room's work and reports a neighbour's agreement to help that plan gives the call and the terms at once, since the terms concern the call itself (paladins-076 c0218): EL-J; it differs from aggies-057 (reading 70), where the ceasefire is reported reached and the attack on a third room arises from it. (88) Where the writers' sides are unclear and the room's encroachment is told at the hour of an offer to negotiate, the order cannot be placed (rainbowgrid-056 c0015, c0022, c0024): EL-J. (89) A reply that answers a conquest call by pointing to an agreement made an hour before is terms held, as the concept's label reads it (romania-033 c0169): S-O-A, INV. (90) An alarm about an attack the room suffers, followed by a proposal to find the makers and compromise, shows no first end (rush-060 c0030, c0031), nor does an alarm answered by a neighbour's agreement (math-059 c0027, c0028): EL-NA. (91) A non-portable restrict line is P-G6, as in the instantiate pass, and PO only where its concepts show the order; russia-058 shows a spread toward one neighbour and restraint toward another that names no terms, so it is not PO. (92) A proposal inside the room to ally, beside restraint, is not terms, as reading 37 (miamidolphins-051 c0126). No line in this window states a condition A17, its bound and its counterexample response lack and shows the order failing without it.

G49's readings 93 to 99, stated while reading A17's restrict window r588_048 (15 lines), before its rows are written; none an amendment. (93) A post that reports overwriting between the rooms as going on and proposes to settle it, from a writer on the other side, shows the order in its words (rust-067 c0164), as readings 13 and 80; so does a post that reports the room stepping on another's work and asks that room to negotiate (schoolidolfestival-029 c0053, c0054), a neighbour's post that holds the room to an agreement while it tells of the room's border removing its work (sheffield-057 c0038, read with reading 45), a neighbour's post that tells of the room's interference and invites talks (vermont-027 c0022; witcher-058 c0065), and a neighbour's post that tells of the room shoving its logo in and refusing compromises (udub-055 c0036; its earlier order to move, c0032, names no place and is P07's appeal): S-O-H. (94) A truce reported in another thread after the room's invasion call follows it by the hours (singapore-057 c0105, c0034): S-O-H; a compromise reported in the same thread after the room's attack call answers it in the thread (starcitizen-063 c0265, c0276): S-O-A. (95) A defence call against a neighbour whose placement the record elsewhere shows was agreed, answered only after hour 73, is after the close (teslamotors-064 c0256, c0260 at h+75.28): EL-AFTER. (96) The coded submission that changes a neighbour's text is the first end, and the neighbour's request that the room write elsewhere answers it in the chain (theexpanse-062: c0001 at h+7.23, then c0004 at h+7.55, R): S-O-A; the room's sharing offer elsewhere in the thread (c0006) is later. (97) The bound's pattern, S-BOUND: a truce offer before the room's first coded call to fight back (titanfall-061 c0109 at h+52.01, before c0114 at h+53.66), and a target's request to work something out before the room's suggestion to push its work elsewhere (totallynotrobots-063 c0211, before c0213). (98) A report of talks already held with a neighbour, answering the room's plan to overtake designs, is terms at the reply's hour, as reading 45 (uva-048 c0012, c0013): S-O-A, INV. (99) Visitors' conditional threats and offers of coexistence, with no act of the room's against another room's work shown, show only terms (vegan-049): EL-ONE; a priority to deal with another room's lines that intrude on the room's work, under a submission that defends that work, is defence (yugioh-071 c0104): EL-NA. No line in this window states a condition A17, its bound and its counterexample response lack and shows the order failing without it.
